38 unmatched calls are the selected saved denominator. Spatial caller/owner contexts and static adapter refinements do not confirm missing features, dynamic receiver identity, source ownership, Codex/ChatGPT mode or runtime behavior.

Historical v1/v2 attempts exited zero and retained their actual source/output. v1 finite-template descriptions were conservatively incomplete; v2 parameter-name identity wording was overstrong. Neither is labeled a failed execution.
